nodes.description: Constant address of the vault contract that is called with allocate() in performUpkeep.
Constant address of the dripper contract that is called with collectAndRebase() in performUpkeep.
Constant address allowed to update the keeper configuration.
Immutable start of the daily execution window in seconds after start of day.
Immutable end of the daily execution window in seconds after start of day.
Day number (block.timestamp / 86400) of the last successful upkeep run; used as one-run-per-day guard.
Public packed configuration: byte 0 holds rebase weekday bits, byte 1 holds allocate weekday bits.
Constructor initialising windowStart, windowEnd and config; no access control (deployment only).
External owner-only function that overwrites the config state variable.
Keeper-compatible view entry point returning whether rebase/allocate should run and echoing checkData as performData.
Permissionless entry point that writes lastRunDay and performs low-level calls to dripper and vault.
Internal view helper that decides runRebase/runAllocate from lastRunDay, block.timestamp window and weekday config bits.
Caller-controlled address, compared against owner in setConfig and uncontrolled in performUpkeep.
Miner/validator-influenced timestamp used for the day counter, the execution window check and the lastRunDay write.
Low-level dripper.call(abi.encodeWithSignature("collectAndRebase()")) whose success value and return data are ignored.
Low-level vault.call(abi.encodeWithSignature("allocate()")) whose success value and return data are ignored.
Constructor parameter assigned to the windowStart immutable state variable.
Constructor parameter assigned to the windowEnd immutable state variable.
Constructor bytes32 parameter written into the config state variable.

Calldata bytes passed to checkUpkeep and returned unchanged as performData.
Calldata bytes passed to performUpkeep, a public entry point supplied by any caller.
Local return value of _shouldRun indicating the dripper rebase should be executed.
Local return value of _shouldRun indicating the vault allocate should be executed.
Local day counter computed as block.timestamp / 86400.
Local seconds-after-start-of-day computed as block.timestamp % 86400.
Local weekday bitmask taken from config byte 0.
Local weekday bitmask taken from config byte 1.

edges.reason: constructor writes its windowStart_ argument into the windowStart immutable.
constructor writes its windowEnd_ argument into the windowEnd immutable.
constructor writes its config_ argument into the config state variable.
Parameter windowStart_ flows into the windowStart state variable.
Parameter windowEnd_ flows into the windowEnd state variable.
Constructor parameter config_ctor flows into the config state variable.
msg.sender is compared to the owner constant to gate the privileged setConfig function.
The owner constant is the reference address used in the setConfig authorization check.
Parameter config_setter flows into the config state variable.
setConfig performs the state write that overwrites config.
checkData calldata is consumed by checkUpkeep and echoed in performData.
performData calldata is supplied by the caller of the permissionless performUpkeep.
checkUpkeep calls the internal _shouldRun helper to evaluate the run flags.
performUpkeep calls the internal _shouldRun helper to evaluate the run flags.
block.timestamp is used inside _shouldRun to derive day and daySeconds, making the run decision timestamp dependent.
performUpkeep writes lastRunDay using block.timestamp / 86400, so the once-per-day guard depends on the miner-controlled timestamp.
lastRunDay is read in _shouldRun to enforce a single run per day.
performUpkeep writes the current day into lastRunDay before performing external calls.
windowStart is compared with daySeconds to decide whether the window is open.
windowEnd is compared with daySeconds to decide whether the window is open.
_shouldRun reads the config state variable to load the weekly schedule.
config is copied into the local _config variable for gas savings.
Local day is derived from block.timestamp / 86400.
Local daySeconds is derived from block.timestamp % 86400.
Local weekday is derived from the timestamp-dependent day value.
Timestamp-derived day feeds the lastRunDay comparison that gates execution.
Timestamp-derived daySeconds feeds the window check that gates execution.
rebaseDays is extracted from byte 0 of _config.
allocateDays is extracted from byte 1 of _config.
The rebaseDays bit for the current weekday sets runRebase.
The allocateDays bit for the current weekday sets runAllocate.
The computed weekday indexes the schedule bitmasks inside _shouldRun.
_shouldRun produces the runRebase return value.
_shouldRun produces the runAllocate return value.
runRebase/runAllocate are returned to checkUpkeep which ORs them into upkeepNeeded.
runRebase/runAllocate are returned to performUpkeep and drive the external calls.
Perform data / upkeep flag produced by checkUpkeep is the keeper-facing result.
The dripper constant address is the target of the low-level call.
The vault constant address is the target of the low-level call.
performUpkeep executes dripper.call(collectAndRebase()) when runRebase is true, ignoring the result.
performUpkeep executes vault.call(allocate()) when runAllocate is true, ignoring the result.
The unchecked low-level call into dripper hands control to external code that can re-enter performUpkeep/checkUpkeep.
The unchecked low-level call into vault hands control to external code that can re-enter performUpkeep/checkUpkeep.
